title: Lanyard
description: A glossy herb.art lab pass hanging on a woven strap. Grab it and throw it: it swings on the strap, twists, and turns itself back to face you while light slides across the clearcoat and the foil. Double-click to turn it over.
intent: One precious object you can fling: a pass on a strap with real weight, a strap that twists with it, and a face that always comes back to you.

sources.name: Vercel, Building an interactive 3D event badge with React Three Fiber
sources.what: The rig (fixed point, three rope links, the card on a ball joint), gravity -40 with heavy damping, the strap drawn as a chordal Catmull-Rom through smoothed rope points, the settle-to-face twist spring (angvel.y += error * 7.5 * dt) and the Lightformer strip lighting. Re-derived as Verlet particles without Rapier or meshline.

sources.name: owu-uy-community website, Lanyard.tsx
sources.what: Read as a reference port of the badge: the strip positions for the PMREM room, the jitter fix that lerps the strap's middle points by min(1, dt * (10 + distance * 40)), and the tab offset where the strap leaves the card. No code copied.

sources.name: Lenis, damp
sources.what: Frame-rate independent damp(x, y, lambda, dt) for the held card and the lean.
